cookieConsent.title: Cookie settings
cookieConsent.body: We use cookies and similar technologies to operate the website and, with your consent, analytics and referral attribution. Necessary cookies are always used. Optional categories are used only after consent.
cookieConsent.necessaryDescription: Required for basic website operation and storing your cookie choice. Always active.
cookieConsent.analyticsDescription: Help us understand how the website is used (for example, Google Analytics 4). Loaded only after consent.
cookieConsent.referralDescription: Allows attributing specialist registrations to partner referral links (freuly_partner_ref, 90 days) only after consent.
